input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: The Base Terms impose no minimum purchase commitment, committed volume, take-or-pay obligation or shortfall charge on Bluefly. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "take or pay", "shortfall", "volume" and "purchase" return nothing of that character: § 4.1 prices Charges only for Services actually ordered under Service Option Attachments/Order Forms (one-time, installment, recurring or usage), § 11.5 addresses capacity planning rather than committed capacity, and § 12.3 confirms no goods are purchased. Bluefly also has a monthly termination-for-convenience right on one month's notice (§ 3.4) plus a no-charge exit if IBM changes the Services (§ 13.1), so there is no locked-in multi-year spend. This meets the preferred position (fees for usage/ordered services only). Two points to note but not redline: § 3.4(b) preserves "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments", and § 3.2 auto-renews each Service Option Attachment for a like term absent 90 days' notice — the attachments should be checked to confirm they contain no minimum-volume or take-or-pay pricing, which would be assessed under this rule when available.
